sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2020. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. 486 pp.
sources.note: Sec. 1.5.1 'Stress' (pp. 31-32): stress has been described only for Mauwake, Pamosu and Usan; 'the available data on stress in most languages are minimal or nonexistent'. Fn. 10 p. 31 and p. 140: the Ukuriguma analysis rests solely on Z'graggen's 1980 wordlist transcriptions. Sec. 4.5 Ukuriguma (p. 158) gives only vowel/consonant inventories, final devoicing of /b/, [s] allophone of /t/; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Carrington, Lois. 1996. A linguistic bibliography of the New Guinea area. Pacific Linguistics D-90. Canberra: Research School of Pacific and Asian Studies, Australian National University. xiii+476 pp. (language index entry 'Ukuriguma', printed p. 471 = p. 483)
sources.note: No phonology content (bibliography). The complete entry reads: 'Ukuriguma (S Adelbert Ra, Madang) Ross 1988, W&H 1981, Z'graggen 1975' - only a comparative Austronesian volume (loanword citation), the Wurm & Hattori 1981 atlas, and Z'graggen 1975; 'Northern Adelbert Range languages' adds Z'graggen 1980. Confirms that no description of Ukuriguma existed as of 1995.
